title: Middle East war live: Lebanese army accuses Israel of ceasefire violations
summary: A 10-day ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon, mediated by the US, went into effect at 5pm EST on Thursday. Lebanon's army soon after reported “acts of aggression” by Israel that it said violated the ceasefire agreement. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: Shortly after a 10-day ceasefire between Lebanon and Israel came into effect, the Lebanese army on Friday accused Israel of violating the truce through a “a number” of aggressions. The army simultaneously called on residents and displaced from the south to exercise caution as they began returning to their homes. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
